p: last words of David: Which he spoke after he had written the psalms.
tongue: Meaning, he spoke nothing but by the motion of God's Spirit.
grass springing out of the earth: Which grows quickly, and fades soon.
grow: But that my kingdom may continue for ever according to his promise.
seat: As one of the king's counsel.
gone away: Meaning, fled from the battle.
hand clave unto the sword: By a cramp which came from weariness and fighting.
great victory: Which has no respect for many or few, when he will show his power.
longed: Being overcome with weariness and thirst.
poured it out unto the LORD: Bridling his affection, and also desiring God not to be offended for that rash enterprise.
spear in his hand: Which was as big as a weavers beam, 1Ch 11:23.
thirty: He was more valiant than the thirty that follow and not so valiant as the six before.
Mebunnai the Hushathite: Some of these had two names, 1Ch 11:29 and also many more are mentioned there.
thirty and seven in all: These came to David, and helped restore him to his kingdom.
